episodes.synopsis: Miyamoto-san is in her senior year and she desperately wants to sing in the upcoming joint recital, but the vice-principal has barred her from doing so. To get back on stage, she will have to take a different approach.
episodes.title: Running and Inviting

episodes.synopsis: Konatsu has finally got a choir team together, but fate continues to throw obstacles in her and the team's path.
episodes.title: Gathering and Struggling

episodes.synopsis: Kona’s Choir club has fallen apart before it had a chance to start. That hasn’t stopped her; she just needs to find 3 new members.
episodes.title: Swinging and Meeting

episodes.synopsis: Konatsu has given then group, Conder Queens, her group's stage for the World Music Festival. Her devotion to the group has caused a rift between her and Sawa.
episodes.title: Getting Angry and Dancing

episodes.synopsis: While the choir group is cheering for Tanaka, Wakana seems to be withdrawing further from the group and tries to move on from her mother’s memories.
episodes.title: Throwing Away and Holding On

episodes.synopsis: Wakana and her father finally have an open talk about what happened to her mother, and what she left behind for her.
episodes.title: Laughing and Remembering

episodes.synopsis: Wakana has officially joined the Choir and Sometimes Badminton Club and all seems well until Sawa starts acting weird.
episodes.title: Spinning in Circles and Losing Sight

episodes.synopsis: Sawa's dedication to getting into the school of her choice is affecting her mentally and physically. She believes that no one understands, but her friends are set to prove her wrong.
episodes.title: Worrying and Racing Ahead

episodes.synopsis: Students are prohibited from having after-school jobs, but the club has no funds to perform at the White Festival. An interesting job offer has been presented but they must have the approval of the vice principal.
episodes.title: Turning White and Turning Red

episodes.synopsis: The group is really getting into their role as Shop Rangers, the vice principal on the other hand is not. She wants them to quit, but the group has other plans.
episodes.title: Crushing and Burning

episodes.synopsis: The students, the parents, and the teachers are shocked to hear that not only is White Festival cancelled, but their normal school life is over.
episodes.title: Waxing and Waning

episodes.synopsis: The White Festival may be over but that is not stopping the Choir and Sometimes Badminton Club—they will put on their show with or without approval.
episodes.title: Piling Up and Rippling

episodes.synopsis: The show must go on as the actors prepare for their last time singing together.
episodes.title: Sunny Days and Crying and Sometimes Singing
